No speckle, holes or states out of region; Capsian, Dadiwan and Xinglongwa end in -5400 on their pages' dates.

The Ubaid shape has a thin northward spike from the gazetteer Babylonia region (bbox reaches 34.98N); minor and left.

Balkans with Cliopatria comparison (empty). Vinca holds the Serbia/Kosovo/Banat core, Starcevo-Koros-Cris keeps a 77-cell remnant east of the Danube and a strip in Bosnia, Linear Pottery holds Transdanubia; no overlaps, no unexplained jump.

issues.what: Keyframe snap vinca-culture_-5400: 48 cells removed (Alba 17, Bekes 7, Vukovar 4, +16 more). Starcevo's -5400 loss to Vinca names the wider Belgrade 150 km, Timisoara 100 km and Deva 70 km zones, but Vinca's found and keyframe region is narrower, so the extra cells end up held by nobody. Below the 200-cell threshold; the pages I had no reason to open say nothing that changes the Vinca extent.

Keyframe snap halaf-culture_-5350: 21 cells added (Kahramanmaras 12, Gaziantep 7, Osmaniye 1). Halaf's -5450 Domuztepe loss removes Kahramanmaras 60 km, then the -5350 keyframe region (Gaziantep 80 km) takes part of it back, so 21 cells flicker out and back with no event. Tiny; the only dated page sentence is the Domuztepe abandonment, which does not say the Halaf lost the region.

Hassuna's dissolve in -5350 hands only the Mosul 100 km zone to Halaf; the Sulaymaniyah 90 km part (51 cells) goes to nobody. Matches the dossier's ledger text (Halaf gain limited to the Tigris piedmont near Mosul).

Ubaid period drawn with a thin northward spike from the gazetteer Babylonia region (Iraqi admin-1 units up to about 35N) in -5500..-5101. The keyframe spans three windows and the spike is a gazetteer-geometry matter of a few cells.

Packet flags: 0 size-rule conflicts, 0 skipped events, 0 unresolved regions, 0 contests or occupations, 0 hierarchy relations. Busiest year -5400 (2626 cells) is the end of Capsian (page: 'ca. 9000 to 5400 cal BC'), Dadiwan ('c. 5800-5400 BCE') and Xinglongwa ('6200-5400 BC', followed by Zhaobaogou), and the birth of Vinca and Zhaobaogou, all dated by the dossiers' own page quotes.
